ezekiel.37.p1.b1.text: The hand of the LORD was upon me, and He brought me out by His Spirit and set me down in the middle of the valley, and it was full of bones.

ezekiel.37.p1.b2.text: Son of man, can these bones come to life?

ezekiel.37.p1.b3.text: I saw a great many bones on the floor of the valley, and indeed, they were very dry.

ezekiel.37.p1.b4.text: O Lord GOD … only You know.

ezekiel.37.p1.b5.text: I will cause breath to enter you, and you will come to life.

ezekiel.37.p2.b1.text: Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD!

ezekiel.37.p2.b2.text: And as I prophesied, there was suddenly a noise, a rattling, and the bones came together, bone to bone.

ezekiel.37.p2.b3.text: As I looked on, tendons appeared on them, flesh grew,

ezekiel.37.p2.b4.text: and skin covered them; but there was no breath in them.

ezekiel.37.p3.b1.text: Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe into these slain, so that they may live!

ezekiel.37.p3.b2.text: and the breath entered them, and they came to life and stood on their feet—a vast army.

ezekiel.37.p3.b3.text: I will put My Spirit in you and you will live

ezekiel.37.p3.b4.text: Our bones are dried up, and our hope has perished; we are cut off.

ezekiel.37.p3.b5.text: O My people, I will open your graves and bring you up from them, and I will bring you back to the land of Israel.

ezekiel.37.p4.b1.text: Won’t you explain to us what you mean by these?

ezekiel.37.p4.b2.text: Then join them together into one stick, so that they become one in your hand.

ezekiel.37.p4.b3.text: My servant David will be king over them, and there will be one shepherd for all of them.

ezekiel.37.p4.b4.text: My dwelling place will be with them; I will be their God, and they will be My people.

ezekiel.37.p4.b5.text: I will take the Israelites out of the nations to which they have gone, and I will gather them from all around and bring them into their own land.
